title: Finding Nemo (2003, animated, rated G)
premise: All characters are sea animals unless stated. Marlin, an anxious clownfish, searches the ocean for his young son Nemo, who was taken by a scuba diver and put in a dentist's fish tank in Sydney.

characters.Nemo: young clownfish with one small fin, Marlin's only child
characters.Dory: friendly blue tang fish with short-term memory loss, Marlin's travelling companion
characters.Bruce, Anchor, Chum: sharks who are trying to stop eating fish
characters.Gill, Bloat, Peach, Gurgle, Bubbles, Deb: fish and sea creatures living in the dentist's tank
characters.Nigel: pelican who is friendly to fish
characters.The dentist (P. Sherman): human who keeps Nemo in his office fish tank
characters.Darla: the dentist's 8-year-old niece, a human child who is rough with pet fish
